svg.title: Follow an Estimate into Settlement
svg.desc: What remains after the supplier invoice uses the estimate? Accrual journal 9: 31 January 2024; Estimated expense: 10,039.33; Accrued liability recognized. Supplier invoice 39851: 9 March 2024; Amount: 10,019.59; Accrual moves into AP. Adjustment journal 698: 11 March 2024; Unused estimate: 19.74; Supplier paid on 20 May
